title: Singing at fish fries and house rent parties with Uncle Charlie
summary: Uncle Charlie let him sing along, and singing at fish fries and rent parties became a regular routine.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So I...uh...my...a friend of mine, Uncle Charlie--I call him Uncle Charlie--he played the piano...he would always teach me different songs, like I said before, so sometimes I'd go down there and, "Play and let me sing."
Say, "You better get back up on them steps."
So, he used to let me...
Say, "Come on. You can sing one. Cain't stay down here long ...too long now."
So he let me sing up a storm. The people like to hear me sing. So it got to be a regular routine there so I learned how to sing, singing at fish fries, house rent parties and stuff like that.
